mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the current level of FEDFUNDS, with lower values predicting positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a housing boom (HOUST > 1300) combined with strong retail sales (RSAFS > 500000) signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, the signal (HOUST>1300 and RSAFS>500000) fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports higher consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the current level of UNRATE, with lower values predicting positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal requires both series to show positive month-over-month growth.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST rising and RSAFS rising) fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 251), a federal funds rate above 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both CPIAUCSL above 251 and FEDFUNDS above 2.0.
failure_condition: In the high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 251), the signal (FEDFUNDS > 2.0) fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
